title: Senate to pass the 64-page UAP disclosure bill again

tellings.quote: they're going to they're going to the Senate is going to pass the the 64page bill again

plain: A lawyer named Danny Sheehan says that in 2025 or 2026 the US Senate is going to pass again the 64-page UAP Disclosure Act, a bill meant to force the government to release its records on UFOs, which it calls unidentified anomalous phenomena. He names politicians Mike Rounds, Chuck Schumer, Marco Rubio and Dan Crenshaw in connection with it. If it passes, it would push the government toward revealing what it holds.
